paite: Ngai un, Pa hon itna thupi hi na tel e! Pathian tate chih a i om; huai mah i hihna uh ahi hi. Hiai khawng ziak in khovel in ahon thei kei hi, amah atheih louh ziak in.
heading: Pathian Tate

paite: Deihtakte aw, tu'n ah Pathian tate i hi ua, bangchi in ahia i om ding chih akithei tadih kei hi; amah ahong kilak chiang in, amah bang in i om ding chih bel i thei hi, amah a-om ngeingei bangtak a mu ding i hi ngal ua.
Amah tung a lametna nei peuhmah amah asiangthou bang in akihihsiangthou hi.
Kuapeuh thil hihkhial dan ah atalek hi; dan a tatlekna khelhna ahi ngal a.
heading: Pathian Tate Leh Diktatna

paite: Amah khelhnate lamang ding in ahong langta chih na thei uhi; amah ah khelhna bangmah a-om kei hi.
Kuapeuh amah a om gige in thil ahihkhial kei; kuapeuh thil hihkhial in amah amu kei a, amah leng athei kei hi.
Tate aw, kuamah khem in om kei un. Diktatna hihmi amah adiktat mah bang in adiktat hi.
Thil hihkhialmi zaw diabol a pawt ahi; diabol in atung a kipan thil ahihkhial hi. Pathian Tapa hong latna pen diabol nasepte ahihmanthat theihna ding in ahi.
Kuapeuh Pathian a suak in amah a Pathian chi a-om gige ziak in thil ahihkhial kei, Pathian a suak ahih ziak in, thil ahihkhial thei kei hi.
Hiai ah Pathian tate leh diabol tate atheihtheih hi; kuapeuh diktatna hih lou Pathian a suak ahi kei a, a-unau it lou leng Pathian a suak ahi kei hi.
Atung a kipan thukhah na zak uh i ki-ittuah chiat ding uh chih ahi.
heading: Unau Ki-ittuahna

paite: Kain, giloupa a kipan amah unau thatpa bang in om kei ni. Bangziak in ahia athah tak? Amah thilhihte agilou a, a-unau thilhihte adik ziak in ahi.
Naute aw, khovel in nou ahon huatleh lamdang sa kei un.
Unaute i it ziak in sihna a kipan in i pawt ua, hinna ah i lutta chih i thei uhi. Kuapeuh itna nei lou sihna ah a-om lai hi.
Kuapeuh a-unau hua tualthat ahi; tualthatmi tangtawn hinna nei a-om kei uh chih na thei uhi.
Hiai ah itna bang ahia chih i thei hi, ama'n eite a dia ahinna apiak tak ziak in; en leng unaute a ding in i hinna i piak sam ding ahi.
heading: Itna Latsakna

paite: Himahleh kuapeuh in khovel sum nei in, a-unau tasam in mu henla, amah lainat tuan kei taleh Pathian itna amah ah bangchi in a-om dia?
Naute aw, thu kia in it kei ni, lei kia in leng it sam kei ni, thilhih leh thutak in hi zaw hen.
Hiai in thutak a suak i hi chih hon theisak a, amah ma ah i lungtang i muangsak thak ding hi.
I lungtang in siam louh ahon tansak dek chiang in chihna ahi; Pathian zaw i lungtangte sang in alianzaw a thil bangkim athei hi.
Deihtakte aw, i lungtang in siam louh ahon tan keileh Pathian lam ah i hangsan hi;
athupiakte i zuih ua, amitmuh a thil kipahhuai i hih zel ziak in i nget peuhmah amah a kipan in i mu zel uhi.
Huan athupiak hiai ahi, a Tapa Jesu Khrist min gingta lehang, ama'n thu ahon piak bang in ki-ittuah chiat lai lehang.
Athupiakte zuimi amah ah a-om gige a, amah mah leng amah ah a-om gige hi. Huan Kha ahon piak ah amah eimau ah a-om gige chih i thei uhi.
